name: Death of Hope

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Frequency once per day

---
You create an aura of absolute despair around you, causing your enemies to struggle against their lamentations. For 1 minute, each enemy entering or beginning their turn within 30 feet of you must attempt a Will save save against the greater of your class DC or spell DC.

---
Critical Success The enemy is unaffected.

Success The enemy is unable to use reactions until the start of their next turn.

Failure As success, and they are Slowed 1 for 1 round.

Critical Failure As success, and they are Slowed 2 for 1 round.
